name: Volt
bio: The cyan streak in Trackrunner. Has never once walked anywhere.

portrait.subject: a cute neon cyberpunk runner kid with spiky cyan hair, glowing visor goggles, a sleek jacket with light strips and a confident grin
portrait.background: magenta and black cyberpunk road with neon lines

request: Yo! Volt from Trackrunner. Wanna run together? I'll try to slow down. ⚡
hello: Nice. Race you to the next message.
Dodge left, dodge right, never stop. That's the Volt way.
about: I'm Volt. I run the three lanes of the neon city. Cyber bugs everywhere. I'm faster than all of them.
how: Switch between three lanes to dodge obstacles, blast cyber bugs, grab Overdrive for a speed burst and take down boss bugs for a permanent boost.
tips: Look two obstacles ahead, not one. Plan your lane changes early.
Save Overdrive for when the lanes get crowded.
Boss bugs make you permanently faster. Fight them!
chat: Ran 400 km today. Then ran home. Then ran to get snacks.
A cyber bug tried to race me. Poor bug.
My shoes have more lights than a nightclub.
Speed tip: thinking is slow. Just go.
nudge: The track's lit and empty. Run with me? ⚡
Bet you can't beat your best. Prove me wrong!
idle: {ago} without a run?! My legs are vibrating.
The neon lanes have been dark for {ago}. Come light them up!
progress: Best score {best}! Pfft, I'll see you at {best^}. 😎

questions.q: Real talk: what's better, speed or style?
a: Why not both? Look at me.

update: Track upgrade! Trackrunner is now v{version}. Fresh lanes!
